healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Verify the personal API key with the cheapest authenticated call, query Me { viewer { id name email } }. Linear can answer HTTP 200 with a populated errors array on an auth failure, so the manifest's bodyErrorPaths demotes that to a failure before this ever returns; on real success this still checks that data.viewer.id is present rather than trusting the status code alone. Takes no input.

body.query: query Me { viewer { id name email } }

issues.create.title: Create Issue
issues.create.description: Create an issue with the issueCreate mutation. teamId is the only non-null field in IssueCreateInput, and title is optional in the SDL but required here because an issue created without one is not meaningfully usable — both are enforced by this schema. Optional fields: description (markdown), assigneeId, stateId, priority (0-4), labelIds, projectId, parentId, cycleId, dueDate (YYYY-MM-DD), estimate, subscriberIds, createdAt (ISO 8601).

teamId.description: Team UUID the issue belongs to. Required — the only non-null field in IssueCreateInput.

assigneeId.description: User UUID to assign the issue to.

stateId.description: Workflow state UUID. Resolve with workflowStates.list.

parentId.description: Parent issue UUID, to create a sub-issue.

subscriberIds.description: User UUIDs to subscribe to the issue.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp to backdate creation. Requires admin scope in practice.

body.query: mutation IssueCreate($input: IssueCreateInput!) { issueCreate(input: $input) { success issue { id identifier title url branchName state { id name } } } }

issues.update.title: Update Issue
issues.update.description: Update an issue with the issueUpdate mutation. id is required and accepts either the issue UUID or the human identifier (e.g. ENG-123). Every IssueUpdateInput field is optional in the SDL, so only the fields you pass are changed. Use addedLabelIds/removedLabelIds to change labels incrementally instead of replacing the whole labelIds set.

id.description: Issue UUID or human identifier (e.g. ENG-123).

stateId.description: Workflow state UUID. Resolve with workflowStates.list.

teamId.description: Move the issue to a different team.

trashed.description: Move the issue to the trash.

body.query: mutation IssueUpdate($id: String!, $input: IssueUpdateInput!) { issueUpdate(id: $id, input: $input) { success issue { id identifier title url state { id name } } } }

issues.get.title: Get Issue
issues.get.description: Fetch a single issue with the issue query. id accepts either the UUID or the human identifier (e.g. ENG-123) — Linear resolves both from the same argument.

id.description: Issue UUID or human identifier (e.g. ENG-123).

body.query: query Issue($id: String!) { issue(id: $id) { id identifier title description url priority createdAt updatedAt state { id name type } assignee { id name email } team { id key name } labels { nodes { id name } } } }

issues.list.title: List Issues
issues.list.description: List issues with the issues query, using Relay cursor pagination. filter is a raw IssueFilter object passed through as-is. first defaults to 50 on the provider side if omitted. Pass the previous call's nextCursor as after to continue; keep paging while hasNextPage is true — endCursor may still be present on the final page since it points at the last returned edge, per Relay semantics.

filter.description: IssueFilter object, passed through to the provider as-is.

after.description: Cursor from a previous call's nextCursor.

body.query: query Issues($filter: IssueFilter, $first: Int, $after: String) { issues(filter: $filter, first: $first, after: $after) { nodes { id identifier title url state { name } assignee { name } updatedAt } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }

issues.search.title: Search Issues
issues.search.description: Full-text search issues with the searchIssues query, using Relay cursor pagination. term is required. This deliberately uses searchIssues, not the deprecated issueSearch(query:) field the SDL marks [Deprecated] — do not switch to it. Pass the previous call's nextCursor as after; keep paging while hasNextPage is true.

after.description: Cursor from a previous call's nextCursor.

body.query: query SearchIssues($term: String!, $first: Int, $after: String) { searchIssues(term: $term, first: $first, after: $after) { nodes { id identifier title url } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }

comments.create.title: Create Comment
comments.create.description: Post a comment on an issue with the commentCreate mutation. No field in CommentCreateInput is non-null in the SDL, but issueId and body are required here because a comment without a target issue or text is not meaningfully usable. Pass parentId to reply to an existing comment thread.

issueId.description: Issue UUID or human identifier to comment on.

parentId.description: Parent comment UUID, to reply in a thread.

createAsUser.description: Display name override for app-authored comments.

displayIconUrl.description: Avatar URL override for app-authored comments.

projectId.description: Project UUID, for a comment on a project update instead of an issue.

body.query: mutation CommentCreate($input: CommentCreateInput!) { commentCreate(input: $input) { success comment { id body url createdAt } } }

teams.list.title: List Teams
teams.list.description: List teams with the teams query, using Relay cursor pagination. Needed to resolve the teamId that issues.create requires. Pass the previous call's nextCursor as after; keep paging while hasNextPage is true.

after.description: Cursor from a previous call's nextCursor.

body.query: query Teams($first: Int, $after: String) { teams(first: $first, after: $after) { nodes { id key name displayName } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }

workflowStates.list.title: List Workflow States
workflowStates.list.description: List workflow states with the workflowStates query. Needed to resolve the stateId issues.update needs for 'move issue to Done' style operations. filter is a raw WorkflowStateFilter object, commonly {team: {id: {eq: teamId}}}. The verified reference documents only filter and first as arguments for this query — no after argument is documented, so this operation returns a single page only; it does not accept an after cursor and does not report pageInfo.

filter.description: WorkflowStateFilter object, passed through to the provider as-is.

body.query: query WorkflowStates($filter: WorkflowStateFilter, $first: Int) { workflowStates(filter: $filter, first: $first) { nodes { id name type position team { id key } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }

projects.list.title: List Projects
projects.list.description: List projects with the projects query, using Relay cursor pagination. Pass the previous call's nextCursor as after; keep paging while hasNextPage is true.

after.description: Cursor from a previous call's nextCursor.

body.query: query Projects($first: Int, $after: String) { projects(first: $first, after: $after) { nodes { id name slugId url state progress } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }

projects.get.title: Get Project
projects.get.description: Fetch a single project by UUID with the project query.

body.query: query Project($id: String!) { project(id: $id) { id name description url state } }

users.list.title: List Users
users.list.description: List workspace users with the users query, using Relay cursor pagination. Needed to resolve the assigneeId that issues.create/issues.update accept. Pass the previous call's nextCursor as after; keep paging while hasNextPage is true.

after.description: Cursor from a previous call's nextCursor.

body.query: query Users($first: Int, $after: String) { users(first: $first, after: $after) { nodes { id name displayName email active } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }

organization.get.title: Get Organization
organization.get.description: Fetch the authenticated workspace's organization with the organization query. Takes no input.

body.query: query Organization { organization { id name urlKey } }

issues.archive.title: Archive Issue
issues.archive.description: Archive an issue with the issueArchive mutation. id accepts either the issue UUID or the human identifier (e.g. ENG-123). Archived issues leave the active board; pass trash=true to move the issue to trash instead of the archive. This cannot be undone from this operation — use Linear's UI or issueUnarchive to restore.

id.description: Issue UUID or human identifier (e.g. ENG-123).

trash.description: When true, move the issue to trash rather than the archive.

body.query: mutation IssueArchive($id: String!, $trash: Boolean) { issueArchive(id: $id, trash: $trash) { success } }

comments.list.title: List Comments
comments.list.description: List comments on an issue via issue { comments }, using Relay cursor pagination. id is the issue UUID or human identifier. Pass the previous call's nextCursor as after; keep paging while hasNextPage is true.

id.description: Issue UUID or human identifier (e.g. ENG-123).

after.description: Cursor from a previous call's nextCursor.

body.query: query IssueComments($id: String!, $first: Int, $after: String) { issue(id: $id) { comments(first: $first, after: $after) { nodes { id body url createdAt user { id name } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } } }

comments.listAll.title: List Workspace Comments
comments.listAll.description: List comments visible to the authenticated user with the comments query over POST /graphql. This is the workspace connection, not comments nested on one issue. Optional includeArchived includes archived comments. Pass the previous call's nextCursor as after.

after.description: Cursor from a previous call's nextCursor.

before.description: Cursor used with last for backward pagination.

includeArchived.description: When true, include archived comments. Provider default is false.

body.query: query Comments($first: Int, $after: String, $before: String, $includeArchived: Boolean) { comments(first: $first, after: $after, before: $before, includeArchived: $includeArchived) { nodes { id body url createdAt updatedAt user { id name } issue { id identifier } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }

comments.update.title: Update Comment
comments.update.description: Update a comment's markdown body with the commentUpdate mutation. id is the comment UUID. body is required because an empty update is not meaningfully usable.

body.query: mutation CommentUpdate($id: String!, $input: CommentUpdateInput!) { commentUpdate(id: $id, input: $input) { success comment { id body url updatedAt } } }

projects.create.title: Create Project
projects.create.description: Create a project with the projectCreate mutation. name and teamIds are required — a project without a name or team is not meaningfully usable. Optional: description, leadId, startDate, targetDate, icon, color, priority.

teamIds.description: Team UUIDs the project belongs to.

leadId.description: User UUID of the project lead.

body.query: mutation ProjectCreate($input: ProjectCreateInput!) { projectCreate(input: $input) { success project { id name url state } } }

projects.update.title: Update Project
projects.update.description: Update a project with the projectUpdate mutation. id is required. Only the fields you pass are changed. Use statusId (a project status UUID) to change state — Linear does not accept the state name on update.

body.query: mutation ProjectUpdate($id: String!, $input: ProjectUpdateInput!) { projectUpdate(id: $id, input: $input) { success project { id name url state } } }

teams.get.title: Get Team
teams.get.description: Fetch a single team by UUID with the team query.

body.query: query Team($id: String!) { team(id: $id) { id key name displayName } }

labels.list.title: List Labels
labels.list.description: List issue labels with the issueLabels query, using Relay cursor pagination. filter is a raw IssueLabelFilter object, commonly {team: {id: {eq: teamId}}}. Pass the previous call's nextCursor as after; keep paging while hasNextPage is true.

filter.description: IssueLabelFilter object, passed through to the provider as-is.

after.description: Cursor from a previous call's nextCursor.

body.query: query IssueLabels($filter: IssueLabelFilter, $first: Int, $after: String) { issueLabels(filter: $filter, first: $first, after: $after) { nodes { id name color description } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }

labels.create.title: Create Label
labels.create.description: Create an issue label with the issueLabelCreate mutation. name is required. Pass teamId for a team-scoped label; omit it for a workspace label. Optional: color (hex), description.

teamId.description: Team UUID. Omit for a workspace-wide label.

body.query: mutation IssueLabelCreate($input: IssueLabelCreateInput!) { issueLabelCreate(input: $input) { success issueLabel { id name color } } }

cycles.list.title: List Cycles
cycles.list.description: List cycles with the cycles query, using Relay cursor pagination. filter is a raw CycleFilter object, commonly {team: {id: {eq: teamId}}}. Pass the previous call's nextCursor as after; keep paging while hasNextPage is true.

filter.description: CycleFilter object, passed through to the provider as-is.

after.description: Cursor from a previous call's nextCursor.

body.query: query Cycles($filter: CycleFilter, $first: Int, $after: String) { cycles(filter: $filter, first: $first, after: $after) { nodes { id name number startsAt endsAt team { id key } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }

users.get.title: Get User
users.get.description: Fetch a single workspace user by UUID with the user query.

body.query: query User($id: String!) { user(id: $id) { id name displayName email active } }

attachments.create.title: Create Attachment
attachments.create.description: Attach a URL to an issue with the attachmentCreate mutation. This is a link attachment (GitHub PR, Figma, Notion, …), not a file upload — file uploads would require the unverified uploads.linear.app host and are out of scope. issueId and url are required. Optional: title, subtitle, iconUrl.

issueId.description: Issue UUID or human identifier to attach to.

iconUrl.description: Icon URL shown next to the attachment.

body.query: mutation AttachmentCreate($input: AttachmentCreateInput!) { attachmentCreate(input: $input) { success attachment { id title url } } }

projects.archive.title: Archive Project
projects.archive.description: Archive a project with the projectArchive mutation. id is the project UUID. Archived projects leave active views; restore later with projectUnarchive. This cannot be undone from this operation.

body.query: mutation ProjectArchive($id: String!) { projectArchive(id: $id) { success } }

projectUpdates.archive.title: Archive Project Update
projectUpdates.archive.description: Archive a project status update with projectUpdateArchive. id is the project update UUID. Archived updates are hidden from the default view and can be restored with projectUpdates.unarchive.

body.query: mutation ProjectUpdateArchive($id: String!) { projectUpdateArchive(id: $id) { success } }

comments.react.title: Add Comment Reaction
comments.react.description: Add an emoji reaction to a comment with reactionCreate. commentId is the comment UUID; emoji is a Unicode emoji or a shortcode such as :thumbsup:.

body.query: mutation ReactionCreate($input: ReactionCreateInput!) { reactionCreate(input: $input) { success reaction { id emoji } } }

issueRelations.create.title: Create Issue Relation
issueRelations.create.description: Create a relationship between two issues with issueRelationCreate. type is one of blocks, duplicate, or related. Both issueId and relatedIssueId must be issue UUIDs.

body.query: mutation IssueRelationCreate($input: IssueRelationCreateInput!) { issueRelationCreate(input: $input) { success issueRelation { id type } } }

projectMilestones.create.title: Create Project Milestone
projectMilestones.create.description: Create a project milestone with projectMilestoneCreate. name and projectId are required. Optional: description (markdown), targetDate (YYYY-MM-DD), sortOrder.

sortOrder.description: Sort order; lower numbers appear first.

body.query: mutation ProjectMilestoneCreate($input: ProjectMilestoneCreateInput!) { projectMilestoneCreate(input: $input) { success projectMilestone { id name targetDate sortOrder } } }

projectUpdates.create.title: Create Project Update
projectUpdates.create.description: Post a project status update with projectUpdateCreate. projectId and body (markdown) are required. Optional health is onTrack, atRisk, or offTrack. isDiffHidden hides the diff against the previous update.

body.description: Markdown body of the status update.

isDiffHidden.description: When true, hide the diff against the previous update.

body.query: mutation ProjectUpdateCreate($input: ProjectUpdateCreateInput!) { projectUpdateCreate(input: $input) { success projectUpdate { id body health isDiffHidden url } } }

teams.create.title: Create Team
teams.create.description: Create a team with teamCreate. name and key are required; key becomes the issue identifier prefix (e.g. ENG-123) and cannot be changed later. Optional: description, icon (Linear icon name, not emoji), color, private.

name.description: Team name shown in the workspace.

key.description: 2-5 character issue prefix (e.g. ENG). Unique and immutable after create.

description.description: Markdown description of the team's purpose.

icon.description: Linear icon name (e.g. Rocket), not an emoji.

color.description: Hex color, with or without a leading #.

private.description: When true, the team is visible only to members.

body.query: mutation TeamCreate($input: TeamCreateInput!) { teamCreate(input: $input) { success team { id key name displayName } } }

issues.delete.title: Delete Issue
issues.delete.description: Permanently trash an issue with issueDelete. id accepts the issue UUID or human identifier (e.g. ENG-123). Prefer issues.archive to hide an issue without trashing it. This cannot be undone from this operation.

id.description: Issue UUID or human identifier (e.g. ENG-123).

body.query: mutation IssueDelete($id: String!) { issueDelete(id: $id) { success } }

attachments.get.title: Get Attachment
attachments.get.description: Fetch an attachment record with the attachment query. id is the attachment UUID returned by issues.get or attachments.create. Returns metadata and the source URL; this does not download bytes from uploads.linear.app.

body.query: query Attachment($id: String!) { attachment(id: $id) { id title subtitle url sourceType createdAt issue { id identifier title } } }

comments.get.title: Get Comment
comments.get.description: Fetch a single comment with the comment query. id is the comment UUID. Returns body, author, timestamps, associated issue, and resolvedAt when the thread is resolved.

body.query: query Comment($id: String!) { comment(id: $id) { id body url createdAt updatedAt resolvedAt user { id name } issue { id identifier } } }

users.me.title: Get Current User
users.me.description: Return the authenticated viewer with query Viewer. Use the returned id for assigneeId and other user-scoped inputs. Takes no input.

body.query: query Viewer { viewer { id name displayName email active admin } }

cycles.listByTeam.title: List Cycles By Team
cycles.listByTeam.description: List cycles for one team via team { cycles }. teamId is the team UUID. Paginate with first/after; pass the previous nextCursor as after.

after.description: Cursor from a previous call's nextCursor.

body.query: query TeamCycles($id: String!, $first: Int, $after: String) { team(id: $id) { cycles(first: $first, after: $after) { nodes { id name number startsAt endsAt } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } } }

teams.issueDefaults.title: Get Issue Defaults
teams.issueDefaults.description: Fetch a team's defaultIssueEstimate and defaultIssueState, used to pre-fill new issues. id is the team UUID.

body.query: query IssueDefaults($id: String!) { team(id: $id) { id defaultIssueEstimate defaultIssueState { id name type } } }

projectUpdates.get.title: Get Project Update
projectUpdates.get.description: Fetch a project status update with the projectUpdate query. id is the project update UUID.

body.query: query ProjectUpdate($id: String!) { projectUpdate(id: $id) { id body health isDiffHidden url createdAt updatedAt project { id name } user { id name } } }

issues.listByTeam.title: List Issues By Team
issues.listByTeam.description: List issues for one team via team { issues }. teamId is the team UUID. Optional includeArchived includes archived issues. Paginate with first/after.

after.description: Cursor from a previous call's nextCursor.

body.query: query TeamIssues($id: String!, $first: Int, $after: String, $includeArchived: Boolean) { team(id: $id) { issues(first: $first, after: $after, includeArchived: $includeArchived) { nodes { id identifier title url state { name } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } } }

issueDrafts.list.title: List Issue Drafts
issueDrafts.list.description: List the authenticated viewer's unpublished issue drafts via viewer { issueDrafts }, using Relay cursor pagination. Pass the previous call's nextCursor as after. Takes no required input.

after.description: Cursor from a previous call's nextCursor.

body.query: query IssueDrafts($first: Int, $after: String) { viewer { issueDrafts(first: $first, after: $after) { nodes { id title description priority createdAt updatedAt team { id key } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } } }

projectUpdates.list.title: List Project Updates
projectUpdates.list.description: List project status updates with the projectUpdates query and Relay cursor pagination. Pass the previous nextCursor as after.

after.description: Cursor from a previous call's nextCursor.

body.query: query ProjectUpdates($first: Int, $after: String) { projectUpdates(first: $first, after: $after) { nodes { id body health url createdAt project { id name } user { id name } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }

issues.removeLabel.title: Remove Issue Label
issues.removeLabel.description: Remove one label from an issue with issueRemoveLabel. id is the issue UUID or human identifier; labelId is the label UUID. Removing a label that is not on the issue succeeds without change.

id.description: Issue UUID or human identifier (e.g. ENG-123).

body.query: mutation IssueRemoveLabel($id: String!, $labelId: String!) { issueRemoveLabel(id: $id, labelId: $labelId) { success issue { id identifier } } }

reactions.remove.title: Remove Reaction
reactions.remove.description: Delete a reaction with reactionDelete. id is the reaction UUID returned by comments.react.

body.query: mutation ReactionDelete($id: String!) { reactionDelete(id: $id) { success } }

comments.resolve.title: Resolve Comment
comments.resolve.description: Resolve a comment thread with commentResolve. id is the root comment UUID. Optional resolvingCommentId is the child comment that resolves the thread.

resolvingCommentId.description: Optional child comment UUID that resolves the thread.

body.query: mutation CommentResolve($id: String!, $resolvingCommentId: String) { commentResolve(id: $id, resolvingCommentId: $resolvingCommentId) { success comment { id resolvedAt } } }

graphql.execute.title: Run Query or Mutation
graphql.execute.description: POST an arbitrary GraphQL document to /graphql. query is the full query or mutation string; variables is an optional JSON object whose keys match the document's variable names. Introspect with __type before guessing field names. This operation can mutate workspace data — confirm the document before executing.

variables.description: Variables object matching the document's $name declarations.

body.query: {{query}}

projectUpdates.unarchive.title: Unarchive Project Update
projectUpdates.unarchive.description: Restore an archived project update with projectUpdateUnarchive. id is the project update UUID.

body.query: mutation ProjectUpdateUnarchive($id: String!) { projectUpdateUnarchive(id: $id) { success } }

comments.unresolve.title: Unresolve Comment
comments.unresolve.description: Reopen a resolved comment thread with commentUnresolve. id is the root comment UUID.

body.query: mutation CommentUnresolve($id: String!) { commentUnresolve(id: $id) { success comment { id resolvedAt } } }

projectUpdates.update.title: Update Project Update
projectUpdates.update.description: Update a project status update with projectUpdateUpdate. id is required; body, health (onTrack/atRisk/offTrack), and isDiffHidden are optional.

isDiffHidden.description: When true, hide the diff against the previous update.

body.query: mutation ProjectUpdateUpdate($id: String!, $input: ProjectUpdateUpdateInput!) { projectUpdateUpdate(id: $id, input: $input) { success projectUpdate { id body health isDiffHidden url } } }

teams.update.title: Update Team
teams.update.description: Update a team with teamUpdate. id is the team UUID. Optional fields follow TeamUpdateInput, including name, key, description, icon, color, private, timezone, cycle settings, triage, auto-close, auto-archive, and git workflow state ids. Only provided fields are sent.

key.description: New issue prefix. Uppercase letters, typically 2-5 characters.

icon.description: Linear icon name, not an emoji.

private.description: When true, the team is visible only to members.

cycleStartDay.description: Cycle start weekday. 0 = Monday through 6 = Sunday.

triageEnabled.description: When true, new issues enter triage first.

autoClosePeriod.description: Months of inactivity before auto-close. 0 disables.

autoCloseStateId.description: Workflow state UUID used when auto-closing.

autoArchivePeriod.description: Months before completed issues are auto-archived. 0 disables.

cycleCooldownTime.description: Cooldown after each cycle, in weeks.

cycleLockToActive.description: When true, lock issues to the active cycle.

upcomingCycleCount.description: How many upcoming cycles to create.

cycleIssueAutoAssignStarted.description: Auto-assign started issues to the active cycle.

cycleIssueAutoAssignCompleted.description: Auto-assign completed issues to the active cycle.

draftWorkflowStateId.description: Workflow state UUID used when a pull request is opened as a draft.

mergeWorkflowStateId.description: Workflow state UUID used when a pull request merges.

startWorkflowStateId.description: Workflow state UUID used when a pull request is opened.

reviewWorkflowStateId.description: Workflow state UUID used when a pull request review is requested.

body.query: mutation TeamUpdate($id: String!, $input: TeamUpdateInput!) { teamUpdate(id: $id, input: $input) { success team { id key name displayName } } }
